summary: Field kit design & assembly for school outreach, sensor housings & student-friendly instrumentation.

affiliation_info: CLEAR WATER LAB, Department of Engineering

supervisor_text: Also working with the outreach group on the school kits.
add_paragraph: Grace is here for a summer, building the kits the lab sends out with schools. Each one is a small grey box with a temperature probe, a light sensor and a set of instructions a fifteen-year-old can follow without being talked down to.
She designed the **assembly sheet** herself, after discovering that the lab's own instructions assumed a person who already knew which end of a screwdriver to hold.
In the autumn she goes back to her second year of upper secondary school, with a project on air quality in the school grounds and an unreasonable amount of confidence about cable strain relief.
